$comment: Publisher and solution identity for THIS PowerApps solution. Renaming the scaffold = editing
There is deliberately no 'assemblies' list: plugin projects declare themselves with
and dv discovers every one under this folder, so adding a project needs no edit here.
solution.uniqueName also seeds every component id dv generates. Changing it re-identifies
everything, so a sync would create duplicates rather than update what is already there.

$comment_packageOutput: Optional. Overrides packageOutputDirectory in dv.json for this solution alone.
Relative to the repo root; '{solution}' is substituted. Leave it out unless this
solution's .zip genuinely belongs somewhere other than all the others.
